actual.descripcion: The Atlanta Dream host the Washington Mystics at the Gateway Center at College Park for a WNBA Commissioner's Cup game. Kiki Iriafen leads Washington with over 10 rebounds per game, while Angel Reese leads Atlanta with over 11 rebounds.

siguiente.descripcion: Adam Silver outlines the NBA's future, with expansion timelines, NBA Europe momentum and possible changes to the NBA Cup; we run the NBA Hater Report on Orlando, Golden State and Cleveland, then play Hammer It or Not as trades are debated.
